: Rachael Ann Emfield, widow of George, died 13 Apr 1918 at the home of J R Smith of Riggles Gap, of congestion of the liver. Born 14 August 1848, daughter of Joseph H and Sarah(McCracken) Glasgow, deceased, and lived most of her life in Riggles Gap. She is survived by brothers and sisters: Mrs David (Matilda) Love, Mrs Jane McCracken, Blair, Joseph, Levi. She attended the Salem Lutheran Church. Funeral Services in Riggles Gap at new Church of Brethren. Interment in Antis Cemetery. (Altoona Mirror, 13 Apr 1918)
